about.lead: I’m Abhinav Singh, a photographer and filmmaker based in Prayagraj, India.
about.body: I photograph fashion, live events, streets, architecture and landscapes, and direct, shoot and edit short films. My work is about light, people and place — moments that tell a story and still feel alive long after they’re captured.
about.available: I’m available for commissions and collaborations.

services.name: Fashion
services.text: Editorial, lookbook and portrait shoots for designers, labels and models.

services.name: Events & concerts
services.text: Concerts, performances and festivals, from soundcheck to encore.

services.name: Street & documentary
services.text: Candid stories of people, rituals and everyday life.

services.name: Architecture & places
services.text: Heritage sites, buildings and landscapes, with care for light and line.

services.text: Trailers, teasers, event films and short-form edits — directed, shot and edited.
